blurb: Steve Thomas brings his unique style of retro-style giclees of famous travel locations. Including prominent places such as Diablo Mountain, Big Sur, Muir Woods, 17 Mile Canyon, Hearst Castle, Coronado Island, San Francisco, and many others. Steve Thomas seeks to draw his fans into a bygone era of tourism and travel that was usually enjoyed from the front and back seats of the 1940s and 50s American automobiles.
